MWI.note: Only cross-border routes for one operator's internet; no national backbone stated.

facts.fact: TNM says it acquired additional fibre routes into Malawi via Zambia (Mchinji/Chipata, from ZESCO/Telecom Namibia and MTN Zambia) and Mozambique (Muloza/Mulanje, from TMCel) after subsea cable cuts left it only the Mchinji/Chipata link.

systems.owner: TNM Plc with ZESCO, MTN Zambia, TMCel

MWI.note: No share of people using the internet stated.

facts.fact: TNM says its internet runs over cross-border fibre links to Zambia (Mchinji/Chipata) and Mozambique (Muloza/Mulanje) that it restored or acquired in May 2024.
